clue.text: Charge nothing at first to make a speech

indicators.note: at first tells us the nothing piece comes before the charge piece

parts.note: nothing is zero, written as the letter O
to charge a price is to rate, as in rating a fee

explanation.surface: Advice to a speaker to waive the fee before giving a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to deliver a formal speech, a straight synonym for making one.

clue.text: No way I take lots of people for admission to ministry

parts.note: no as nought, the letter O
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
a nation is a great many people

explanation.surface: A churchgoer complains of being blocked from entry by a crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordination is the ceremony that admits someone to the Christian ministry.

clue.text: Principal characters in a Shakespeare season — Titania loved one

indicators.note: principal characters are the leading letters of each following word

explanation.surface: A theatre season's lead roles, with a nod to the fairy queen's beloved.
explanation.walkthrough: In A Midsummer Night's Dream, Titania is bewitched into loving Bottom, who wears an ass's head.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairy queen Titania doted on Bottom when he had been given a donkey's head.

clue.text: Start to' explain to companion dictionary said nothing original

indicators.note: start to means take only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order
OED is the Oxford English Dictionary

explanation.surface: A dictionary that repeats what others said is no help explaining to a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: To have echoed is to have repeated another's words, saying nothing new.

clue.text: Brief shower supplying lack

parts.note: brief means short
a shower of rain or snow is a fall

explanation.surface: A short burst of rain fails to provide what is needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortfall is a deficit, the amount by which something falls short, so a lack.

clue.text: One making economies in ambulance equipment?

definitions.meaning: someone who stretches resources, making money go further
a portable bed for carrying the injured

explanation.surface: Someone cutting costs in the provision of medical kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretcher is a carrying bed for casualties, and whimsically one who stretches a budget.

clue.text: Charming award given to a husband

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: A delightful prize presented to a married man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charming' reads as an adjective but is a noun: the casting of charms.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeah is a Caribbean form of sorcery, the practice of casting spells and charms.

clue.text: Most dense coppice blocks front of shed

indicators.note: blocks as in obstructs, the coppice standing round the letter

parts.note: a coppice is a thicket of small trees

indicators.note: front of means the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: Thick woodland obstructs the front of a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: Thickest is the superlative of thick, meaning most dense or most stupid.

clue.text: Beginners find it difficult to evaluate short game

indicators.note: short means a letter is cut from the end of the word

parts.note: to evaluate is to assess
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Novices struggle to judge a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: The asses' bridge (pons asinorum) is Euclid's fifth proposition, a proverbial stumbling block for slow learners.
explanation.definitionFit: The asses' bridge is the traditional name for a problem that defeats beginners.

clue.text: Told story in song

explanation.surface: A tale recounted through song.
explanation.definitionFit: Lied is the past of lie, fib, and also a German art song, as by Schubert.

clue.text: Acquit cashier

definitions.meaning: to acquit someone is to ... them, release from a charge
to cashier an officer is to dismiss him from service

explanation.definitionFit: Discharge means both releasing someone from accusation and dismissing someone from a post.

clue.text: Children making an important point

definitions.meaning: offspring, as in dying without children
a matter in dispute, the key point at stake

explanation.surface: Kids proving to be the big question.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue means offspring in legal language and also the central matter under discussion.

clue.text: Small earthquake unremarkable

definitions.meaning: read literally, a tremor that is no big quake
ordinary, not much good, an idiom

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for something mediocre also describes, literally, a quake that is mild.

clue.text: Youthful innocence getting roughed up in southern Irish glens

indicators.note: roughed up means knocked about, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: An innocent youngster is beaten up in the glens of southern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Girlishness is the quality of being like a young girl, suggesting youthful naivety.

clue.text: Cries when post is brought round? I'd bet on it

indicators.note: brought round means the post piece wraps around the other

parts.note: a stake is a post
weeps means cries

explanation.surface: People shout when the mail arrives, sure of winning.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweepstake is a lottery-style bet, so the thing one would place a bet on.

clue.text: Biblical city expelling US sailors

indicators.note: expelling means throwing out, so the letters of US leave the city name

parts.note: Tarsus, birthplace of St Paul in Acts

explanation.surface: An ancient city throws out American seamen.
explanation.definitionFit: Tars is old slang for sailors, from tarpaulin.

clue.text: Little Tom's hands make this an excruciating instrument

parts.note: Tom Thumb, the tiny hero of folk tale, so his name possessive gives Thumb's
hands are workers on a ship, a crew

explanation.surface: A tiny boy's workers build a torture device.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'this' is a link pointing on to the definition; 'hands' as crew members, not body parts, is the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A thumbscrew is a torture device crushing the thumbs, literally an excruciating instrument.

clue.text: Resist me, maiden? Wrong!

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

indicators.note: wrong means incorrect, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A hypnotist taunts a young woman that she cannot refuse him.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesmerist is a hypnotist, one whose subjects cannot resist him.

clue.text: Not wholly fair share of food for some length of time

indicators.note: not wholly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a fair share is a due one, what is owed
a ration is an allotted portion of food

explanation.surface: Sharing food unfairly over a period.
explanation.definitionFit: Duration is the length of time something lasts.

clue.text: People are dying to get noticed by him

definitions.text: People are dying to get noticed by him

parts.words: People are dying to get noticed by him
parts.note: being dying to get noticed sounds like craving attention, but literally the dead are noticed in his obituary notices

explanation.definitionFit: A writer of obituaries notices people only once they have died.

clue.text: Axe commercials on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio means heard rather than seen, so a sound-alike

parts.note: commercials are ads

explanation.surface: Cutting advertisements from radio broadcasts.
explanation.definitionFit: An adze is a cutting tool similar to an axe with its blade at right angles to the handle.

clue.text: Short period in incredible servitude

indicators.note: in means the short period sits inside the other word

parts.note: tall as in a tall story, hard to believe
HR is short for hour

explanation.surface: A brief spell in unbelievable bondage.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrall is the state of being in bondage, as in being held in thrall.

clue.text: Principal has finished lists completely

parts.note: a principal of a school is the head
has finished means is over
a ship that lists heels over, leans

explanation.surface: A headteacher has completed the registers.
explanation.definitionFit: Head over heels is an idiom for totally, as in being completely in love.

clue.text: Start off funereal card game

indicators.note: start off means the opening letter is removed

parts.note: funereal means sombre

explanation.surface: A gloomy card game begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Ombre is an old three-handed card game popular in the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: Impudent sort of face

explanation.surface: A cheeky kind of face.
explanation.definitionFit: Bold means brazen, and bold face is a heavy printing type.

clue.text: Marks piece of Gobelin

indicators.note: piece of means only part of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Stains on a bit of Gobelin tapestry.
explanation.walkthrough: Gobelin is the famous Paris tapestry works.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeli are dagger-shaped marks used in printing and in old texts to flag dubious passages.

clue.text: Woman bidden to take charge of the rollers

definitions.text: Woman bidden to take charge of the rollers

parts.words: Woman bidden to take charge of the rollers
parts.note: the song commands a female figure to rule the waves, the rollers being sea waves, not hair curlers

explanation.definitionFit: The patriotic song Rule, Britannia orders the female personification of Britain to rule the waves.

clue.text: Sweep up raised bits of velvet

indicators.note: up in a down clue means read from bottom to top

parts.note: to pan a camera is to sweep across a scene

explanation.surface: Brushing up the pile of velvet cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Nap is the raised pile of fibres on velvet and similar fabrics.

clue.text: Appalling deficits involved new purge

indicators.note: involved means taken in, so the new letter goes inside
appalling suggests something wrecked, so the letters of deficits are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dreadful budget gaps call for a new clean-out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appalling' turns DEFICITS into DISIFECT and 'involved' puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To disinfect is to cleanse of germs, so to purge in the sense of clean out.

clue.text: Fault in circuits reported

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so the word heard is a sound-alike

parts.note: circuits of a track are laps

explanation.surface: A mistake made during the laps of a race, as told.
explanation.definitionFit: A lapse is a slip or minor failing, a fault.
